alternatives_rejected.why: Frontend latency rose 573%, much less than recommendationservice's 3110-4472% (E1). The external errors fit downstream latency spreading up to the user-facing tier, not a frontend fault.
It does not appear among the significant deviations in the all-services ranking (E1). Recommendationservice's latency deviation is the largest and is confined to that service (E2).

Own-span self-time is unchanged at 1.07->1.06ms (E3), and only latency metrics deviate for this service (E2). Resource exhaustion would slow its own processing; here only caller-observed latency rose (3.85->204ms, E3), which points to a network delay.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the injected network delay (e.g. tc/netem qdisc or service-mesh fault rule) on recommendationservice pods. If it cannot be found, restart or reschedule the pods and confirm caller-observed latency drops back to about 4ms.
